premises.reasoning: Precondition holds. App.tsx:600 renders <ReviewBoard key={reviewViewer ?? "active-gh"}>, where reviewViewer is githubAccount?.login (App.tsx:171-172), refreshed only on mount, window focus and project settings (App.tsx:200-225, :295-298); ReviewBoard keys ProjectBoard by [cwd, expectedViewer] (ReviewBoard.tsx:80) and ProjectBoard keys RepositoryBoard by [cwd, repo] (:85). accessLost (:182-193) changes none of these keys, so the board stays mounted unless the shell later sees a different login (or a disconnect/reconnect that flips the login through undefined). After accessLost, clearPrivateView() without reset keeps state but drops updatedWithin (:133, model.ts:18-20), so a Merged/Closed scope with a period reloads at once on the kept state, and without a period it reloads on Refresh (attempt, :106-107, :253); identity.current is "" so replaceAttention is true (:230) and the set is seeded from a snapshot whose cards are all non-open, which needsViewerAttention rejects (model.ts:38): the set is empty and stays empty while the saved filters (re-read at :232-236 because filterKey was cleared) remain historical. Path (2) holds too: clearPrivateView(true) at :209 is followed in the same callback by setFilters(readReviewFilters(nextFilterKey)) at :235, so the new identity's saved historical filters win and no open load follows. Pre-existing is accurate: at 1b994df18 the load callback (base :198-207) started from an empty set when replaceAttention and added only cards with state open; on a merged/closed snapshot it added nothing, and accessLost cleared the set (base :170) and called clearPrivateView() the same way, with the same App key (base App.tsx:600) and the same setFilters ordering (base :191, :211). The outcome on both paths is therefore identical at the merge base (empty set, indicator off until Open or All is chosen); only the predicate differed, and it is irrelevant for non-open cards. No recorded intent makes this an accepted limit: the comment above replaceAttention (from b040c853f/dc6491839, before this branch) says closed/merged-only views cannot replace the open snapshot, which supports the finding rather than excusing it; the accessLost comment is about not restoring the private snapshot, not about leaving the indicator dark after recovery; acceptance-criteria.md AC4, plan.md 'Tab indicator rule', description.md, the journal (T16/T18 entries, commit 20b535531) and docs/requirements/keryx-desktop-review-v2/ name no such limit. Note for the fixer: seeding from the historical snapshot is equivalent to a plain reset here; the defect is that no open load seeds the set after an identity reset on a historical scope, which is what the finding's problem and fix describe.
